name: gnos
description: A teaching harness that diagnoses the learner's reasoning gap and selects the right teacher, subject guidance, and learning artifact.

interface.shortDescription: Learn difficult ideas with subject-aware teachers.
interface.longDescription: GNOS diagnoses the learner's exact reasoning gap, selects focused subject and teacher context, and uses text, code, diagrams, PDFs, or animation when each representation helps.
defaultPrompt: Teach me a difficult idea from the point where my reasoning breaks.
Help me understand this computer-science concept with a useful diagram.
Build a course around what I want to be able to do.
